2653-2893-6763-8336.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Amanda Grayson trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4279-4616-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4616-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2023-4770-5295-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

465-585-3742-4251-6965.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

710-1703-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-7452.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

2292-6566--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-6566--5--195.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

789-2438-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
789-2438-2946-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

392-3292-3892-5434.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-5434.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

549-933-2388-6587.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
549-933-2388-6587.description:
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

4659-6291-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Stridehangar Automaton with haste and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Stridehangar Automaton with haste and two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing the Thopters and a Stridehangar Automaton, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1417-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3180-5220-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Warhost's Frenzy.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Chamber Sentry from your library.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4050-6730-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4779-6972-7155.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2907-5412.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2907-5412.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

101-232-1235-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Vampire Charmseeker tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

552-2757-3887-5094.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight basic Swamps.
552-2757-3887-5094.description:
Activate Cabal Stronghold by paying {3} and tapping it, adding at least eight {B}.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}, creating a creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping Cabal Stronghold.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1545-3490-4017-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-3490-4017-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

413-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Ornithopter enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2232-6749-6913.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-6749-6913.description:
Cast Chameleon either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} plus commander tax if applicable. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Chameleon enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chameleon from the battlefield to your hand.
When Chameleon leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Chameleon from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

3480-4251-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3480-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

4222-5268-6210.easyPrerequisites: Neerdiv does not have summoning sickness.
4222-5268-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

411-2376-4103-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have cycled Yidaro at least three times this game.
411-2376-4103-4613.description:
Activate Yidaro's cycling ability by paying {1}{R} and discarding it.
Yidaro triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Resolve the Yidaro cycling ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yidaro using Grinning Ignus's ability by paying {1} and returning Yidaro from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

1074-4222-4365.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping King Macar.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating two Gold artifact tokens.
Activate the Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1121-1283-2091.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight tapped lands.
1121-1283-2091.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {5}.
Holding priority, activate Mishchievous Quanar's morph ability by paying {3}, turning it face up.
Mischievous Quanar triggers, copying Mana Geyser.
Resolve the copy of Mana Geyser, adding {1} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Activate Mischievous Quanar's first ability by paying {5}, turning it face down.
Repeat from step 2.
If opponents control nine or more tapped lands, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then use to activate Mischievous Quanar to get infinite copies of any other instant and/or sorcery spell(s) on the stack.

1124-1636-1677-2034-4091.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1124-1636-1677-2034-4091.description:
Activate Chandra's second loyalty ability by putting zero loyalty counters on it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Resolve the second Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping target artifact or creature.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Elemental tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Repeat.

1185-1818-1852-2308-3099.notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1185-1818-1852-2308-3099.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Healer of the Pride triggers, holding priority, activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {1}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 3 life due to Knight of Dawn's Light.
Prize Pig and Trudge Garden trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters of Prize Pig, then removing all ribbon counters from Prize Pig and untapping it.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2625-4694.notablePrerequisites: Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2625-4694.description:
Activate Kibo by tapping it, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
The Bananas enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers for each Banana created, and Kibo triggers for each Banana your opponents created.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve all Kibo triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each Ape and Monkey you control.
Repeat.

643-1700-1729-4696-5048.description:
Activate Meldweb Strider by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target and three damage to itself.
Meldweb Strider dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Meldweb Strider that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Meldweb Strider token by removing an oil counter from it, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

744-2034-2835.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
744-2034-2835.description:
Activate Pegasus Refuge by paying {2} and discarding a card, creating a 1/1 Pegasus creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pegasus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Pegasus dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2128-3263-4701.description: Cast Heliod's Intervention by paying {2} due to Hinata, destroying all of your opponents' permanents.

967-2034-3705-3809-4666.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {C}{C}.
Squee dies, triggering Planar Void, exiling Squee from your graveyard.
Cast Squee from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

872-1636-4300.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card on the battlefield that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce at least {1}.
Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
872-1636-4300.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
The Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1987-2427-3227-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

776-1329-1414.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-1414.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of of any color.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Jeskai Ascendacy first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
